text: Will the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool be fully repaired before September 2026?
yes: Working title-based definition: repair work on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool is complete and the pool is refilled and operating normally before 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. An official completion/opening statement or corroborated reporting establishing both qualifies.
no: The above completion and normal-operation conditions have not both occurred before the deadline.
void: Original Metaculus criteria differ materially from this working definition; do not treat this pilot as an exact contract score without reconciliation.
resolution_source: National Park Service completion notices and contemporaneous reporting; original Metaculus criteria unavailable.
